Premium Drones Georgia is the official and exclusive XAG dealer in the Caucasus region.

Built from real field work.

Questions customers ask

What is a spraying drone?

A spraying drone is an agricultural drone that applies crop protection products over a field automatically, following a GPS/RTK route. The XAG P150 MAX also spreads granules and carries cargo.

How does drone spraying differ from conventional spraying?

The drone never drives into the field: no soil compaction or crop damage, it works on wet ground and slopes, applies a precise rate, and the operator stays away from the chemicals. Choose the product and rate with your agronomist.

How much does the XAG P150 MAX cost in Georgia?

XAG P150 MAX packages: Starter ₾75,999, Pro ₾85,999, Business ₾104,999. See every price and what each package includes in the shop.

Where can I buy XAG drone parts?

From Premium Drones Georgia, the official XAG dealer. Original parts, batteries, chargers and generators are in stock in Georgia, with prices in lari in the shop.

Does Premium Drones Georgia offer service in Georgia?

Yes. We do diagnostics, repairs and maintenance with original parts. Service is in Tbilisi (by appointment), with field support from Lagodekhi.

Can the P150 MAX be used for cargo transport?

Yes. The P150 MAX carries up to 80 kg of cargo, for example to deliver materials and equipment to hard-to-reach places. Contact us for details.

Can the P150 MAX spread granules?

Yes. With its 115 L granule container, the P150 MAX spreads granular fertiliser, seed and other granules. See the specifications on the P150 MAX page.

Do you train drone operators?

Yes. PDG Academy teaches drone operation and care in practice, in the field.
